raw.query: WITH current_eda AS (SELECT run_id, window_name, window_requests, window_span_s, is_current, superseded_by, (superseded_by IS NOT NULL) AS is_superseded, (is_current AND superseded_by IS NULL) AS is_effective FROM provenance.v_dim WHERE experiment='eda' AND is_current=true AND run_id IN ('eda:a_quality','eda:b_marginals','eda:j_classes')), marginal_metrics AS (SELECT max(value_num) FILTER (WHERE metric_path='numimages.share_text_only') AS text_only_share, bool_or(value_bool) FILTER (WHERE metric_path='numimages.all_perfect_squares') AS all_perfect_squares FROM provenance.eda_metric m JOIN current_eda d USING (run_id) WHERE m.run_id='eda:b_marginals'), grid_counts AS (SELECT substring(m.metric_path FROM '^context_tokens_by_numimages\.([0-9]+)\.count$')::bigint AS num_images, m.value_num::bigint AS requests FROM provenance.eda_metric m JOIN current_eda d USING (run_id) WHERE m.run_id='eda:a_quality' AND m.metric_path ~ '^context_tokens_by_numimages\.[0-9]+\.count$'), grid_summary AS (SELECT count(*) AS grid_bins, sum(requests) AS grid_total_requests, sum(requests) FILTER (WHERE num_images=0) AS zero_image_requests, sum(requests) FILTER (WHERE num_images>0) AS image_bearing_requests, sum(num_images*requests) FILTER (WHERE num_images>0) AS total_images, sum(requests) FILTER (WHERE round(sqrt(num_images::numeric))>10) AS derived_frames_requests, sum(num_images*requests) FILTER (WHERE round(sqrt(num_images::numeric))>10) AS derived_frames_images, sum(requests) FILTER (WHERE num_images>0 AND floor(sqrt(num_images::numeric))^2<>num_images) AS nonsquare_image_bearing_requests, sum(requests) FILTER (WHERE round(sqrt(num_images::numeric))>10 AND floor(sqrt(num_images::numeric))^2<>num_images) AS nonsquare_frames_requests, string_agg(num_images::text || ':' || requests::text, ', ' ORDER BY num_images) FILTER (WHERE num_images>0 AND floor(sqrt(num_images::numeric))^2<>num_images) AS nonsquare_breakdown FROM grid_counts), class_summary AS (SELECT sum(c.requests) AS class_request_denominator, sum(c.request_share) AS request_share_sum, sum(c.image_share) AS image_share_sum, max(c.requests) FILTER (WHERE c.class_name='text') AS text_requests, max(c.request_share) FILTER (WHERE c.class_name='text') AS text_request_share, max(c.requests) FILTER (WHERE c.class_name='frames') AS frames_requests, max(c.request_share) FILTER (WHERE c.class_name='frames') AS frames_request_share, max(c.image_share) FILTER (WHERE c.class_name='frames') AS frames_image_share FROM provenance.eda_request_class c JOIN current_eda d USING (run_id) WHERE c.run_id='eda:j_classes'), status AS (SELECT count(*) AS current_run_count, bool_and(is_current) AS all_current, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_superseded) AS current_superseded_count, bool_and(NOT is_superseded) AS all_not_superseded, bool_and(is_effective) AS all_effective, count(DISTINCT window_name) AS distinct_windows, string_agg(DISTINCT window_name, ',' ORDER BY window_name) AS windows, string_agg(run_id || '@' || coalesce(window_name,'<null>') || ':' || coalesce(window_requests::text,'<null>'), '|' ORDER BY run_id) AS window_breakdown FROM current_eda) SELECT s.current_run_count, s.all_current, s.current_superseded_count, s.all_not_superseded, s.all_effective, s.distinct_windows, s.windows, s.window_breakdown, mm.text_only_share, mm.all_perfect_squares, gs.grid_bins, gs.grid_total_requests, gs.zero_image_requests, gs.image_bearing_requests, gs.total_images, gs.derived_frames_requests, gs.derived_frames_images, gs.derived_frames_requests::numeric/gs.grid_total_requests AS derived_frames_request_share, gs.derived_frames_images::numeric/gs.total_images AS derived_frames_image_share, gs.nonsquare_image_bearing_requests, gs.nonsquare_frames_requests, gs.nonsquare_breakdown, cs.class_request_denominator, cs.request_share_sum, cs.image_share_sum, cs.text_requests, cs.text_request_share, cs.frames_requests, cs.frames_request_share, cs.frames_image_share, (SELECT count(*) FROM provenance.metric_supersession WHERE superseded_run_id LIKE 'eda:%' OR current_run_id LIKE 'eda:%') AS eda_metric_supersession_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM provenance.ingest_correction WHERE table_name IN ('eda_metric','eda_request_class')) AS eda_ingest_correction_rows FROM status s CROSS JOIN marginal_metrics mm CROSS JOIN grid_summary gs CROSS JOIN class_summary cs
raw.observed: all_current=true, all_effective=true, current_superseded=0, one fulltrace window with 1,000,000 requests per relevant run; text_only_share=0.5; all_perfect_squares=false; zero_image=500000; image_bearing=500000; total_images=14332170; frames=27183 (0.027183), 11636828/14332170 images (0.8119376200533485); 53 nonsquare image-bearing requests (14 frames); class denominator=1000000; supersession/corrections=0
